ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_advantage_abs_weighted
ir.intuition: To fix novelty and avoid similarity with prior squared advantage losses, replaced squaring the advantage_gap with taking its absolute value. This still emphasizes confident pairs but uses a distinct signal transformation. Retained logsigmoid as the link for stable probabilistic pairwise loss. Negated score difference remains to keep proper direction. This change reduces similarity while maintaining meaningful weighting by the advantage magnitude.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_abs = abs(advantage_gap)
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = -logsigmoid(score_diff) * adv_abs * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(score_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, adv_abs)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
